## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 32 runs, 3-9 to 3-40; 3-1 to 3-8 absent. D 6 (3-9 to 3-31) and 4 (3-32 to 3-40). D_r 0.45 and gamma 45.9 in every run (table); text 2-110 (PDF 135) gives about 0.4 for the soil 3 roller beds. 3-37 and 3-38 V_H have broken digits. Bed density control for the RS drag runs in F2-60 (b68-dens-f2-60-s01 to s04). Missing: fill depth of each bed and runs per bed, footpad dimensions beyond D (the 4 inch pad not at all), whether the pad pivot was free or locked, how the pad was brought to depth d, A_ft and A_pt values, per-run density (g_p varies, D_r and gamma are one value per table), gravity (Earth inferred).
- Codex: 32 runs. Starts at 3-9. Table D_r and gamma constant. F2-60 plots higher varying DPT-derived densities for this run series. Exact pad profile and run-specific fill depth unreported.
